our_interpretation: The antecedent requires workers to have been dismissed because an employer expected LLMs to replace their work, followed by those replacements falling short.

The plain reading predicts the return of displaced workers. Restoring similar roles or cancelling proposed dismissals is relevant but does not necessarily establish that those workers were hired back.
The statement predicts a general pattern, rather than merely the existence of one reversal.
criteria.support_condition: Documented employment histories show displaced workers returning because their LLM replacements failed, across the companies covered by the general claim.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A qualifying employer definitively eliminates the possibility of rehiring its displaced workers after the LLM replacement fails. Continued non-rehiring alone cannot establish failure without a deadline.
